table_assessment.assessment_notes: All 18 recommendation rows are assertion-bearing. Most concern assessment, counselling, imaging, delivery, referral, or surgery, while two rows direct corticosteroid or prophylactic-antibiotic use; this medication/non-medication mixture requires row-level adjudication.

entities.surface_form: known or suspected congenital or acquired cardiovascular and aortic disease

normative_assertions.notes: Pre-pregnancy risk assessment is indicated for the stated population.
Pre-pregnancy counselling is indicated for the stated population.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Pre-pregnancy risk assessment and counselling is indicated in all women with known or suspected congenital or acquired cardiovascular and aortic disease.

entities.surface_form: all women with cardiac diseases of childbearing age

normative_assertions.notes: Risk assessment is recommended before and after conception using mWHO classification.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended to perform risk assessment in all women with cardiac diseases of childbearing age before and after conception, using the mWHO classification of maternal risk.

normative_assertions.notes: High-risk patients are directed to specialized-centre care by the multidisciplinary team.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended that high-risk patients are treated in specialized centres by a multidisciplinary pregnancy heart team.

normative_assertions.notes: Foetal echocardiography by experienced specialists is conditional on elevated foetal-abnormality risk.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Foetal echocardiography by experienced specialists is recommended when there is an elevated risk of foetal abnormalities.

entities.surface_form: unexplained or new cardiovascular signs or symptoms

normative_assertions.notes: Echocardiography is recommended for pregnant patients with the stated signs or symptoms.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Echocardiography is recommended in any pregnant patient with unexplained or new cardiovascular signs or symptoms.

entities.surface_form: after 24 weeks and before 37 weeks of gestation

normative_assertions.notes: Corticosteroid administration is recommended when cardiac surgery occurs in the stated gestational interval.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: If cardiac surgery is to be performed after 24 weeks and before 37 weeks of gestation, then corticosteroids are recommended for the mother.

normative_assertions.notes: Vaginal delivery is recommended for most patients, with exceptions explicitly signalled elsewhere.
source_trigger_texts: is recommended as the first choice

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Vaginal delivery is recommended as the first choice in most patients; for most important exceptions see below.

normative_assertions.notes: Induction is conditionally advised at 40 weeks for women with cardiac disease.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Induction of labour should be considered at 40 weeks of gestation in all women with cardiac disease.

entities.surface_form: congenital heart disease or congenital arrhythmia, cardiomyopathies, aortic disease, or genetic malformations associated with CVD

normative_assertions.notes: Genetic counselling is conditionally advised for women with the listed conditions.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Genetic counselling should be considered in women with congenital heart disease or congenital arrhythmia, cardiomyopathies, aortic disease, or genetic malformations associated with CVD.

normative_assertions.notes: MRI without gadolinium is advised when echocardiography cannot establish a definite diagnosis.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: MRI (without gadolinium) should be considered if echocardiography is insufficient for a definite diagnosis.

normative_assertions.notes: The delivery and analgesia approach is advised for patients with severe hypertension.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: In patients with severe hypertension, vaginal delivery with epidural analgesia and elective instrumental delivery should be considered.

normative_assertions.notes: Delivery before necessary surgery is advised at the stated gestational-age threshold.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Delivery before necessary surgery should be considered when gestational age is ≥26 weeks.

entities.surface_form: dilatation of the ascending aorta >45 mm, severe aortic stenosis, pre-term labour while on oral anticoagulants, Eisenmenger's syndrome, or severe heart failure

normative_assertions.notes: Caesarean delivery is advised for the listed obstetric or cardiovascular indications.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Caesarean delivery should be considered for obstetrical indications or for patients with dilatation of the ascending aorta >45 mm, severe aortic stenosis, pre-term labour while on oral anticoagulants, Eisenmenger's syndrome, or severe heart failure.

normative_assertions.notes: Chest radiography is permitted when other methods do not clarify dyspnoea.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: A chest radiograph may be considered if other methods are not successful in clarifying the cause of dyspnoea.

normative_assertions.notes: Cardiac catheterization is permitted only under very strict indications.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cardiac catheterization may be considered with very strict indications.

normative_assertions.notes: CT and electrophysiological studies are permitted for selected patients with vital indications.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: CT and electrophysiological studies may be considered in selected patients for vital indications.

entities.surface_form: conservative and medical therapy has failed
situations that threaten the mother's life or that are not amenable to percutaneous treatment

normative_assertions.notes: The stated surgeries are permitted during pregnancy under failed-therapy or life-threatening/non-percutaneous conditions.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Coronary bypass surgery or valvular surgery may be considered during pregnancy when conservative and medical therapy has failed, and in situations that threaten the mother's life or that are not amenable to percutaneous treatment.

normative_assertions.notes: Administration of prophylactic antibiotics to prevent endocarditis during delivery is recommended against.

source_grade_records.notes: Source-native class preserved without cross-system inference.
Source-native level preserved without cross-system inference.

text_units.verbatim_text: Prophylactic antibiotic therapy to prevent endocarditis during delivery is not recommended.
